name: Zhen
about: Zhen is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 珍 can mean 'precious' or 'rare,' 真 means 'real' or 'genuine,' while 贞 can express virtue, loyalty or integrity. Used across genders, Zhen is a concise name with several positive interpretations rooted in Chinese language and culture.

name: Zhi
about: Zhi is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 志 means 'will,' 'purpose' or 'ambition,' while 智 means 'wisdom' or 'intellect.' Used across genders, Zhi is a compact name associated with determination, thought and personal character.

name: Zohar
about: Zohar is a Hebrew name meaning 'light' or 'brilliance.' Its imagery evokes radiance, brightness and illumination, giving it a naturally luminous character. Used across genders in Hebrew, Zohar is a distinctive name with deep cultural roots and a striking modern sound.

name: Ziv
about: Ziv is a Hebrew name meaning 'bright' or 'radiant.' Ziv was also the ancient Hebrew name of the second month of the Jewish calendar, giving the name a connection with both light and history. Used across genders, Ziv is short, vivid and memorable.

name: Zan
about: Zan is a Chinese given name associated with the character 赞, meaning 'help' or 'support,' alongside other characters with similar pronunciation. Used across genders, Zan is an exceptionally concise name carrying an outward-looking association with encouragement and support.

name: Zanokuhle
about: Zanokuhle is a name used in Xhosa and Zulu and means 'come with goodness.' It is formed from roots associated with coming or approaching and goodness or beauty. Used across genders, Zanokuhle brings a distinctive Southern African naming tradition into the collection while expressing an uplifting idea.

name: Zawadi
about: Zawadi is a Swahili name meaning 'gift,' derived from Arabic zawād, referring to provisions. Its meaning gives the name an immediate association with generosity, gratitude and something precious received. Used across genders, Zawadi is a warm and internationally distinctive name rooted in East African language and culture.

name: Zayan
about: Zayan is an Arabic name meaning 'beautiful.' Its concise form and positive meaning give it a contemporary quality while remaining rooted in Arabic language and naming tradition. Used across genders, Zayan is a graceful gender-neutral name associated with beauty and positive expression.

name: Zhenya
about: Zhenya is a Russian and Bulgarian diminutive of names including Yevgeniy, Yevgeniya and related forms of Eugene. Because the underlying forms exist across genders, Zhenya is used for people of more than one gender in these naming traditions. Familiar within Eastern European cultures yet distinctive internationally, Zhenya has a warm and approachable character.

name: Zihan
about: Zihan is a Chinese given name with several established character combinations, including 子涵, 梓涵 and 紫涵. 子 can mean 'child,' 梓 refers to the catalpa tree, while 涵 means 'to contain' or 'include.' Used across genders, Zihan combines natural imagery with ideas of depth, growth and openness.

name: Zayaan
about: Zayaan is an Arabic name and alternate transcription of Zayan, associated with the meaning 'beautiful.' Its positive meaning and contemporary sound make it an appealing international choice. Used across genders, Zayaan adds a distinctive Arabic option to the collection.

name: Zhannur
about: Zhannur is a Kazakh name combining elements associated with the soul or spirit and light. The name evokes inner light, warmth and vitality. Used across genders, Zhannur brings a distinctive Central Asian name to the collection.

name: Zheng
about: Zheng is a Chinese name with several possible character forms and meanings. Depending on the characters used, it can be associated with ideas such as being right, proper or correct, or with government and administration. Used across genders, Zheng is concise and culturally significant.

name: Zikomo
about: Zikomo is a Chewa name and expression associated with 'thank you' and greetings. Its meaning centres on gratitude, appreciation and social connection. Used across genders, Zikomo brings a warm and distinctive southeastern African name into the collection.

name: Zimo
about: Zimo is a Chinese given name with several possible character combinations. A common interpretation uses 子, associated with a child or learned person, and 墨, meaning 'ink.' This gives the name associations with learning, literature and creativity. Used across genders, Zimo is a distinctive modern Chinese choice.

name: Zirui
about: Zirui is a Chinese given name with multiple possible character combinations. Forms such as 子睿 combine an element associated with a child or learned person with 睿, meaning wise or farsighted. Used across genders, Zirui has a thoughtful and intellectual character.

name: Zixuan
about: Zixuan is a Chinese given name whose precise meaning depends on the characters chosen. Different character combinations can create associations with ideas such as highness, elegance, or the daylily plant. Used across genders, Zixuan is a well-established contemporary Chinese choice.

name: Zola
about: Zola is a Xhosa name derived from an element meaning 'calm.' Its meaning evokes peace, composure and a gentle character. Used across genders, Zola adds a concise and culturally rich Southern African option to the collection.

name: Zedong
about: Zedong is a Chinese given name whose characters can combine meanings associated with grace or brilliance and the east. It is a rare but documented gender-neutral Chinese name and provides an unusual addition to the Z collection.
